label: Diagram 9.5
caption: Diagram 9.5 | Flues penetrating compartment walls or floors | Fire‐stopping
description: 'See para 9.23' is at the top left, and a green bar along the bottom reads 'Diagram 9.5 Flues penetrating compartment walls or floors'. The drawing has two parts. Part a, headed 'a. Flue passing through compartment wall or floor', shows two upright grey rectangles, the flue walls, with a narrow vertical gap between them that is the flue. A horizontal grey band, the compartment wall or floor, meets them at the same level on both sides. A label 'Compartment wall or floor' points to the left band, 'Flue' to the gap between the flue walls, and 'Flue wall' to the right upright rectangle. The text below reads: 'Flue walls should have a fire resistance of at least one half of that required for the compartment wall or floor and be of class A1 construction.' Part b, headed 'b. Flue built into compartment wall', shows two side-by-side plans, each a horizontal grey band with a hollow square grey block on it; in the left-hand plan the band passes through the middle of the square, while in the right-hand plan the band is also level but the square sits on top of it, projecting to one side. Each plan is labelled 'Compartment wall', pointing to the band. The text below reads: 'In each case flue walls should have a fire resistance of at least one half of that required for the compartment wall and be of class A1 construction.'

check.note: Misreads both parts: in a the compartment wall runs level on both sides and the flue is the gap between the two flue walls (no flue "at a higher level"); in b right, the band is level and the flue sits proud of it, not on a stepped band. Leaves out the fire-resistance text.

model_description: 'See para 9.23' is at the top left, and a green bar along the bottom reads 'Diagram 9.5 Flues penetrating compartment walls or floors'. The drawing has two parts. A label 'Compartment wall or floor' points to the left horizontal band, 'Flue' to the horizontal flue, and 'Flue wall' to the right upright rectangle. Explanatory text sits below. Part b, headed 'b.
